purpose: Track losing unplaced LoL recommendations as model-improvement candidates without treating them as official bets, realized profit/loss, or probation wagers.

prohibitedUse: treating an unplaced recommendation as an official wager
changing the active model from a single unplaced result without review

candidates.event: Nongshim RedForce vs BNK FEARX — Game 3

recommendationState.notableBreakpoint: BFX Mordekaiser was 4/0/1 with a two-level advantage
recommendationState.thesis: BFX could control the map through Ziggs structure pressure while Mordekaiser and Galio suppressed NS short-range engage

candidates.finalOutcome: NS won Game 3 after a major BFX throw; the final kill total exceeded 30.5, so the recommendation would have lost
modelErrorCandidates: The model over-weighted the early 6-1 kill lead and fed Mordekaiser as evidence of a controlled close.
The model under-priced NS's forced-fight density from Renekton, Pantheon, Aatrox and Leona when behind.
The model assumed Ziggs-led structure conversion without requiring enough confirmed tower and objective control.
The model under-priced throw and comeback branches in a composition with multiple melee commitment tools on both sides.
The projected 64-67% Under probability was too high for the observed structural uncertainty.
reviewQuestions: Should early live kill unders require at least one confirmed structural-control conversion, not only a gold and kill lead?
Should four-or-more hard-engage or forced-entry champions on the trailing team add a fight-density penalty to kill unders?
Should the model apply a throw-risk penalty when the leading composition lacks a conventional marksman and depends on execution-heavy side-lane or isolation tools?
Was the probability estimate overconfident relative to the uncertainty in objectives, towers and current item completions?
